# PowerLawScalingClassification

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The empirical observation that classification performance of small-scale models follows a power-law relationship with model size or data volume. Provides a predictive scaling rule for designing resource-constrained TCC/iNEST nodes, guiding trade-offs between network topology complexity and neuromorphic compute capacity.
